title: Rabbi Yose bar Mamal
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7, with the further printed locator 18.

He rules that a woman of priestly descent may leave the Land of Israel. At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:7, however, the statement is attributed to Rabbi Dosa Mamlachya. Hyman considers the Kiddushin reading corrupt and proposes reading it as in Sotah.

notes.text: The last numeral18 is a further locator, not a range of halakhot7–18. Kiddushin1:7 names Yose bar Mamal; Sotah3:7 names Dosa Mamlachya and Acha in the name of Elazar. Hyman’s proposed correction remains his textual judgment.
